evidence.quote: The Committee also will purchase longer-term Treasury securities after its program to extend the average maturity of its holdings of Treasury securities is completed at the end of the year, initially at a pace of $45 billion per month.
currently anticipates that this exceptionally low range for the federal funds rate will be appropriate at least as long as the unemployment rate remains above 6-1/2 percent
strains in global financial markets continue to pose significant downside risks to the economic outlook.
Inflation has been running somewhat below the Committee’s longer-run objective
Although the unemployment rate has declined somewhat since the summer, it remains elevated.

parsed.rationale: The statement expands asset purchases with new $45 billion monthly Treasury buys and adopts threshold guidance that keeps rates near zero until unemployment falls below 6.5 percent. It also emphasizes downside risks and below-target inflation, making it strongly dovish.
